game: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games
project: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays through the menus into Alpine Skiing Downhill at 60 fps on both machines (mini PC: 60.0 fps, no frame over 20 ms in 40 s; it was 48.6 fps before the runtime drew the run's 21,000 small shapes a frame faster). Known difference from Dolphin's picture of the same recorded frame: the skier's shadow on the snow is missing in the Downhill. All of the game's code modules run as native code. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the Downhill. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
